about: a package for 2.12 keeps the rules before 2.15: every child has an integer w and h, children follow each other from the container's corner with gap, the 2.15 fields and look are ignored, spacer, fit, whole floats a 32-bit Lua cannot hold as integers and an x past 32767 are refused, and the grid, stack and layout methods give invalid_argument; a child outside the container is drawn whole, and the children before an invalid one stay registered though the call is refused (oracle s36; the rest probe-confirmed except the fit record, which follows the contract text, and the 32-bit and x records, which are not measured; x_32768 is D15)
